summary: Added three maths kinds (real return after inflation, a rising monthly price, income tax by bands) with independent number checks and a checked UK tax example Short. Shorts beats over 5 s with more than 3 s and no event now get a pacing warning in the number check.
why: Both maths proposals were research template/high and had waited two nights; the UK Budget (28 Oct) frozen-allowance topic in the feed had no way to compute a tax figure. The pacing rule is in CLAUDE.md, and 30 beats in the last 10 Shorts break it. Both experiments still have no data (0 of 8 Shorts and 0 of 4 long videos per arm), so nothing to close.

findings.title: 7 videos with 48 h data
findings.detail: Both running experiments wait: hook-voice-matches-frame 0 of 8 Shorts per arm (about 8 more days), quiet-bed 0 of 4 long videos per arm.

findings.title: No recurring failures
findings.detail: The evaluator lists no QA or fact reason repeated twice in 3 days.

findings.title: Shorts beats stand still for 3–6 s
findings.detail: 30 beats over 5 s in the last 10 Shorts have a gap of 3.2–5.8 s with no event, often where a long figure is spoken. Some may be false positives where a scene animates by itself (headline, source).

findings.title: Early pattern (n = 3–5)
findings.detail: Palette ember 1.45× median 48 h views; 19:00 IST uploads 0.66×; 90–99 BPM 0.32×. Too few videos to act on.

changes.title: Maths kinds real_return, price_rise, income_tax_bands
changes.detail: renderer/models/maths.py and closed forms in generator/numbers.py; documented in the long_story README; examples/short_story_tax.json. 1,500 random input sets agree.

changes.title: Pacing warning for long Shorts beats
changes.detail: number-check prints WARN for a beat over 5 s with more than 3 s between events; render logs the measured gaps. Writer note in short_story/README.md. Warning only, never a failure.
